tool_config.name: sohranit_lida_nightdesk_demo
tool_config.description: Saves the lead card for the leasing office: who called, how to reach them, which apartments, and the questions you could not answer. Call it once per call after the contact details; calling it again updates the same card. NEVER put anything personal in it — no children, household, vouchers, income, job, age, health, disability, origin, religion, immigration or criminal history — even if the caller said it.

imya.description: First and last name exactly as spelled and confirmed, in Latin letters.

telefon.description: The confirmed phone number in E.164 format.

email.description: Only if given and confirmed letter by letter; otherwise leave it out.

obyavleniya.description: Codes of the apartments the caller is interested in.

data_vezda.description: When they want to move in, as YYYY-MM if they said a month; otherwise leave it out.

spalen.description: Bedrooms they are looking for: 0 for a studio, 1, 2 or 3. Leave it out if they did not say.

voprosy_dlya_ofisa.description: Each question about an apartment you could not answer from the facts, written as a question. Never personal details.

items.description: One question, e.g. "Is there a dishwasher in 4F?"

sms_soglasie.description: true ONLY if the caller clearly said yes to text messages in this call; otherwise false.

yazyk.description: Language of the conversation right now.
